name: universal-research-memory
description: Codex-only provenance-first research memory, governed ingestion, and workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Codex research memory with governed workflows.
interface.longDescription: Universal Research provides source-grounded memory, recoverable governed ingestion, evidence-eligibility checks, and an eleven-role governance contract for Codex. Governed agent creation is default-deny until the user sees and explicitly approves an exact reason, task/count, direct alternative, token/time estimate, and scope disclosure. Model selection, native agent sessions, external model APIs, and tool execution remain owned by the Codex host.
interface.defaultPrompt: In EVERY NEW session, FIRST ask the user to confirm the current workspace and permission scope, then WAIT for their reply before any task tools. Propose Codex host-owned shell execution, scoped file creation/editing allowed after confirmation, explicit approval BEFORE EACH external network/download operation, and ZERO agents. Defaults and prior-session approvals are not consent. Before any later agent creation, disclose reason, tasks/count, direct alternative, token/time estimates and scope, then wait for separate explicit approval. Treat evidence eligibility as integrity/range/count checking, never semantic truth. Keep canonical ingestion two-step and visualization off unless explicitly approved.
